subject: Change strlcat function name from redis to valkey (#440)
reason: The change only renames the internal C helper redis_strlcat to valkey_strlcat (declaration in util.h, definition in strl.c, two call sites in rdb.c's rdbRemoveTempFile, and the text of a compiler deprecation attribute in fmacros.h). The function body and call-site semantics are unchanged; it is a compile-time identifier rename with no observable behaviour change in commands, replies, persistence, replication, or any other runtime path, so there is nothing a scenario could exercise differently between the two builds.
